body.name: Normal-fan and Gaussian-score classification handle \(\mathscr H_{\mathrm{idx}}\)
body.construction: Derive a finite certificate from the covariance-whitened endpoint-face normals, the incidence pattern of faces hit by \(\Pi^{\mathrm{fc}}\), ridge factorization of the Gaussian-mixture scores \(B_{\pi}\), and the annihilator space of bounded perturbations that preserve every binding convolution moment; use it to decide \(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{all}}\), \(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{co}}\), or \(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{none}}\).
